# Myers Fiction

> > Kenneth W. Myers' speculative fiction portfolio and comprehensive writing craft resource for sci-fi and fantasy authors.

This site serves both readers discovering Myers' original works like *The Great Salt Bowl* and writers developing their craft through detailed guides on plot structure, world-building, and character development. The Authors of Tomorrow community provides a collaborative space for emerging speculative fiction writers.

## Key Topics

- Kenneth W. Myers
- Plot structure and story architecture
- World-building for speculative fiction
- Character arcs and transformation
- Science fiction and fantasy writing
- The Great Salt Bowl (cli-fi short story)
- Three-act structure
- Snowflake Method
- James Scott Bell's techniques
- Writing craft and process
- Beta readers and revision
- Speculative fiction community
- Author newsletters and updates

## Fiction Works & Author Info

- [Kenneth W. Myers](https://myersfiction.com): Homepage for Kenneth W. Myers' speculative fiction and writing insights
- [Storylines](https://myersfiction.com/storylines): Catalog of Kenneth W. Myers' fiction works with summaries and status
- [The Great Salt Bowl: A Short Story](https://myersfiction.com/storylines/the-great-salt-bowl-a-short-story): Cli-fi survival story set in toxic Great Salt Lake wasteland
- [Readers of Tomorrow](https://myersfiction.com/readers): Author bio, published works, and newsletter signup for readers

## Plot & Story Structure Guides

- [Introduction to Plot and Structure: The Backbone of Storytelling](https://myersfiction.com/2025/01/14/introduction-to-plot-and-structure-the-backbone-of-storytelling): Foundational guide to plot elements and story architecture
- [The Five Essential Elements of Plot](https://myersfiction.com/2025/01/21/the-five-essential-elements-of-plot): Breakdown of inciting incident, rising action, climax, and resolution
- [The Three-Act Structure: A Time-Tested Framework](https://myersfiction.com/2025/02/25/the-three-act-structure-a-time-tested-framework): Guide to three-act structure from Aristotle's Poetics to modern storytelling
- [The Midpoint: Turning the Tables on Your Protagonist](https://myersfiction.com/2025/04/15/the-midpoint-turning-the-tables-on-your-protagonist): Deep dive on story midpoints using James Scott Bell's techniques
- [Plot Twists: Surprising Your Readers (Without Losing Them)](https://myersfiction.com/2025/06/10/plot-twists-surprising-your-readers-without-losing-them): Psychology and techniques for effective plot twists with examples
- [The Snowflake Method: Growing Your Plot from a Central Idea](https://myersfiction.com/2026/01/06/the-snowflake-method-growing-your-plot-from-a-central-idea): Randy Ingermanson's Snowflake Method for iterative plot development

## World-Building & Character Development

- [World-building 101: Crafting Immersive Fictional Worlds](https://myersfiction.com/2024/02/13/world-building-101-crafting-immersive-fictional-worlds): Beginner's guide to world-building in sci-fi and fantasy
- [Character Arcs: How to Drive Transformation and Growth in Sci-Fi and Fantasy Stories](https://myersfiction.com/2024/04/16/character-arcs-how-to-drive-transformation-and-growth-in-sci-fi-and-fantasy-stories): Character transformation techniques for speculative fiction writers
- [Parallel Universes: Crafting Alternate Reality Stories](https://myersfiction.com/2024/07/23/parallel-universes-crafting-alternate-reality-stories): Guide to writing parallel universe and alternate reality narratives

## Writing Process & Craft

- [How to Begin Your First Draft](https://myersfiction.com/2022/09/27/how-to-begin-your-first-draft): Starting techniques for first drafts using key scene method
- [Dream to Novel: Step-by-Step Guide for Writers](https://myersfiction.com/2019/09/13/how-to-write-a-book-from-a-dream-part-1): Transform dreams into novels with step-by-step development process
- [Beta Readers: Getting Feedback from Knowledgeable Fans](https://myersfiction.com/2024/12/17/beta-readers-getting-feedback-from-knowledgeable-fans): How to prepare manuscripts and work effectively with beta readers
- [How to Get Back into Writing After a Break](https://myersfiction.com/2022/06/28/writing-after-a-break): Tips for resuming writing practice after extended breaks

## Writing Community & Updates

- [Authors of Tomorrow](https://myersfiction.com/writers): Writing community hub for authors to develop craft and grow together
- [Posts](https://myersfiction.com/posts): Blog archive covering writing craft, novels, and author updates
- [Kenneth W. Myers – October Newsletter](https://myersfiction.com/2025/10/01/kenneth-w-myers-october-newsletter): October 2025: Lords of Wishermoore progress and The Great Salt Bowl updates
- [Myers Fiction May 2025 Newsletter](https://myersfiction.com/2025/05/06/myers-fiction-may-2025-newsletter): May 2025: Character arcs in speculative settings with author spotlight
- [Myers Fiction January Newsletter 2025](https://myersfiction.com/2025/01/07/myers-fiction-january-newsletter-2025): January 2025: Plot/world-building integration with J.A. Andrews spotlight
- [Mastering Revision in Sci-Fi and Fantasy Writing](https://myersfiction.com/2024/12/03/myers-fiction-december-newsletter-5): December 2024: Revision/editing skills with Story Grid Method
